queries:
SELECT MediaTypeId FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId ORDER BY AVG(UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT m.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_milliseconds, AVG(t.Milliseconds) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track) AS ratio
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY avg_milliseconds DESC;
WITH mt_avg AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT m.Name
FROM mt_avg a
JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = a.MediaTypeId
WHERE a.avg_price > (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM mt_avg);
SELECT m.Name
FROM MediaType m
JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
HAVING AVG(il.UnitPrice) > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine);
SELECT m.Name
FROM MediaType m
JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
HAVING AVG(t.Milliseconds) > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE MediaTypeId IS NOT NULL);
